dog.description_text: Meet Daffodaisy — New Arrival! Daffodaisy just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQBgCkwKfCWITb4F87l2uJwKAV2O32HsjcIKGHJ8v3lbdFk?e=AtUVRc Her foster says "She is the sweetest most cuddly dog I’ve ever cared for. She’s basically a lapdog despite her size which is honestly pretty small still. Over the last 24 hours, she has been nothing but cuddles, a good walker, and a joy to care for. Any home would be more than lucky to have her ❤️. She’s the definition of quiet and cuddly. She melts my heart every day with how sweet she is." She has been spayed, vaccinated, and microchipped and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
